newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'bishi Elec plans 97/98 chip investment Y115 bln.
newsitem.headline: M'bishi Elec plans 97/98 chip investment Y115 bln.

text.p: Mitsubishi Electric Corp said on Thursday that it plans capital investment of 115 billion yen for semiconductor production in 1997/98.

The company aims to boost the production capacity of 64 megabit dynamic random access memory (DRAM) chips to four million per month by the beginning of the 1998/99 business year from the current one million per month, a company spokeswoman said.
It also plans to expand production of embedded random access memory (eRAM) chips, which are large-scale integrated circuits installed in DRAM chips.
The company aims to produce 530 billion yen worth of semiconductors in 1997/98, up 10.4 percent from the previous year.
